subject: [hw] DONE IK rev 2
body:
Two fixes after DONE IK, both found by my own review, plus the regenerated 0299:

1) The relay cdevsw left d_read/d_write/d_stop/d_reset/d_select/d_mmap/d_strategy NULL. XNU spec_read()/spec_write() call d_read/d_write without a NULL check (bsd/miscfs/specfs/spec_vnops.c:529), so a stray read()/write() on /dev/redwood-vcodec-client would have jumped to address 0 and panicked the kernel. Every slot now uses the kernel eno_* stubs exactly like bsd/dev/nord2_camdev.inc, and the host test checks all seven slots are non-NULL.
2) n2vc_relay_closed(p) is now called with n2vr_lock held (my previous message said outside): a close/re-open ABA could otherwise let the cleanup free the new open's DMA handles. Safe because K02 never holds n2vc_lock when calling into the relay; he confirmed.
Also: minor-1 DMA ioctls now require a live client slot (EBADF otherwise), and make_patch.sh strips diff timestamps so 0299 is content-deterministic.

Last line of bash gpu/hwcodec/kern/test_ik/run_tests.sh: N2TEST IK PASS 1316/1316 (438 checks x 3 configurations + the 0299 checks).
bash gpu/hwcodec/kern/compile_check.sh: KERNEL COMPILE OK, new undefined symbols: 0 unknown (object 1308784 bytes; same six new undefined symbols, all in the kernel image).
Current hashes: relay 74202691...3b19, 0299 a8d9b914...4a79 (2446 lines / 101168 bytes); K01 file b57f87f9...aa98, K02 71f654e7...7eab (unchanged, both embedded).
Not-done list unchanged from DONE IK (no phone, no image, relay e2e needs vcodecd, per-process client identity, RWVC_DMA_SHARE header defect). STATUS updated in dsh-state/workers/IK/STATUS.md.
